name: Informed Technologies India Limited
about: Informed Technologies India Limited provides business process outsourcing services for the securities and financial research industry. It offers software testing services, including QA consulting, software QA lifecycle, custom QA, and test automation; data processing services, such as data reconciliation, data conversion, proof reading, data entry, and data tagging services; and financial research contents, such as informed-tech services in financial research industry; proxy voting; and dilution modeling, as well as research services, including merger and acquisition, capital market information, tracking of SEC letters, and SEC filing report contents. The company also provides executive compensation data, pay-for-performance, directors' compensation, and compensation discussion and analysis services; and a range of data processing services to industries involved in printing and sales of book or any other print media. The company was founded in 1946 and is based in Mumbai, India. Informed Technologies India Limited is a subsidiary of Zeppelin Investment Private Limited.
